name: Hoozuki Rila
source: A girl with the appearance of an angel, but who is actually devilish and charismatic. With her ingenious fashion sense and makeup skills, she is also a popular fashion model among high school girls. While she has a sharp tongue in that she calls the other students “weeds,” she is also sincere in that she never laughs at the strides of others. In fact, she is actually a secret otaku to a very extreme degree.
